entries.source: Urkundenbuch des Cistercienserstiftes B. Mariae V. zu Hohenfurt in Böhmen, Nr. II. , S. 15, II.
entries.german:
1259. 23. Mai, Thin. — Bischof Johann von Prag bestätigt die von dem böh mischen Landesmar-schalle, Wok von Rosenberg, den Cisterciensern gemachte Schenkung des Patronatsrechtes über die Kirchen in Priethal und Rosenthal.

II. Johannes dei gratia Pragensis episcopus vniuersis presens scriptum inspecturis salutem in domino perpetuam. Justis petentium desideriis iustum est prebere assensum, et uota que a racionis tra- mite non discordant, complere effectu debito consequente. Sane cum in peticione viri nobilis Wokonis de Rosenberc, marsalci regni Boemie, dilecti compatris nostri, acceperimus humili et deuota, ut donacionem suam, quam ipse super ecclesiis in Rosental et in Pre- dol, quarum ad ipsum ius peitinuit patronatus, fratribus Cisterciensis ordinis ob amorem eins, quem ipsi fratres salcatis illecebris huius mundi pauperem pauperes imitantur, pro remedio anime sue suorum- que parentum sollempniter fecit, pleno iure in perpetuum possi- dendam ratificare et confirmare nostris litteris curaremus: nos qui etiam ex debito dictum ordinem interne caritatis bradais amplec- timur, puro corde peticioni buic, que uidetur racionabilis et honesta, ex sinceris affectibus annuentes donacionem huiusmodi in nomine patris et fila et spiritus sanctî duximus confirmandam. In cuius rei testimonium et uigorem presentes litteras nostri sigilli munimine fecimus roboran. Datum in Thin anno domini M° CC° LIX°, Xo Ka- lendas Junii, pontificatus nostri anno primo. Ziemlich grosses, an Pergamentstreifen hangendes und gut erhaltenes Siegel in weissem Wachs. — Ein Bischof in seinem Ornate, sitzend, in der Rech ten einen Stab, ¡n der Linken ein Buch.haltend. — y Siguí. Johis. (Johis steht in kleinerer Schrift unter Sigill.) Di. Gra. See. Pragen. Ecclie. Episcopi. — Das kleine runde Gegensiegel weist einen Adler mit ausgebreiteten Flügeln. — Sigillvm. Secretor.
entries.english:
On 23 May 1259, Bishop Johannes of Prague confirms the gift made by Wok von Rosenberg, marshal of the Bohemian realm, to the Cistercians of the right of patronage over the churches at Priethal and Rosenthal.

Johannes, by the grace of God Bishop of Prague, to all who inspect this document, perpetual greeting in the Lord. It is right to assent to the just wishes of petitioners and to fulfill, with due effect, vows that do not depart from the path of reason. Since we have received the humble and devout petition of the noble Wok von Rosenberg, marshal of the Bohemian realm and our dear co-father, asking that by our letters we ratify and confirm for perpetual possession the gift he solemnly made to the brothers of the Cistercian Order, for love of Him whom those brothers imitate in poverty, having spurned the enticements of this world, for the salvation of his soul and those of his parents: the churches at Rosenthal and Predol, whose right of patronage belonged to him; we, who also embrace that Order with inward charity as duty demands, gladly assent with sincere affection to this reasonable and honorable petition and have decided to confirm this gift in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. As testimony and to give it force, we have strengthened this letter with our seal. Given at Thin in the year of the Lord 1259, on the tenth day before the Kalends of June, in the first year of our pontificate.

A rather large, well-preserved seal hangs from a parchment strip, made of white wax. It depicts a bishop seated in vestments, holding a staff in his right hand and a book in his left. Inscription: Seal of Johannes, by the grace of God Bishop of the Church of Prague. The small round counterseal shows an eagle with outstretched wings, inscribed “Secret seal.”
